data.title: Road to Esports Nations Cup 2027 Expands Competition Opportunities for National Teams, Offers More Matches for Fans
data.content:
Riyadh, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The Esports Foundation today announced an expansion of the Road to the Esports Nations Cup, introducing events organized by national team representatives, new qualifying tournaments, expanded national team rosters, and a dedicated tournament ranking system.
    The Road to the Esports Nations Cup 2027 offers players more opportunities to represent their countries and regions while giving national teams greater opportunities to compete. It also allows fans to follow more matches throughout the season, building excitement and momentum ahead of the inaugural Esports Nations Cup finals, scheduled for November 2027.
    The qualifying stage for the Esports Nations Cup saw around 200,000 players compete in 210 regional qualifying tournaments, with 2,000 players from 123 countries and regions securing places in the competition. National teams will retain all the places they qualified for in 2026, while players who represented those countries and regions will be included in expanded team rosters. Coaches will select the final tournament lineups from these rosters.
    Countries and regions that have not yet qualified will have another opportunity to participate through new online regional tournaments, followed by in-person LAN qualifiers. The online regional qualifiers will begin on February 26, 2027, and run for five weeks across a range of games. The schedule for each game and details of the in-person LAN qualifiers will be announced later.
    Further details on the Esports Nations Cup rankings, the schedule for the new qualifiers, and events organized by national team representatives are expected to be announced in the coming weeks.
    -- SPA
